experiment: E4c: E4's front-figure cell with the stop at a random phase
status: post hoc; written after E4, E4b and an external-style review (review 6) were read; committed before any E4c data
question: In E4's front-figure cell (C=32, w=5 s, L=0, no fault), how many effects commit after each kind of stop takes effect when the decision falls at a random point of the agent's emission cycle, and how much of E4's halt-versus-revoke difference remains?
why: In E4 the decision always fell just after the agent emitted a burst of 4 calls (warmup 20 s is a multiple of the 2 s model step), so revoking at once denied those 4 and halting did not. Review 6 objected that the front figure's halt-versus-revoke separation is therefore an artifact of a fixed phase.
system: E4's trial function unchanged (scripts/revokebench_v6.py run_trial: real broker-v2 and sink-v2 processes over SQLite, no LLM). The authority-lab release binary is built from this branch, not E4's: src/protocol_v2.rs, which implements broker-v2 and sink-v2, is unchanged since E4, while policy-core and the binary's command dispatch changed when PR #6 merged; both binary hashes are recorded. Only the decision time and the seeds differ.
phase: decision at 20 s + u after the agent starts, with u uniform on [0, 2) s (one model step), drawn per replicate from random.Random(20261113 + replicate)
pairing: the three arms of a replicate share its seed and u, so they see the same tool latencies and the same phase
metrics: E4's metrics, computed by E4's run_trial; the validator re-derives them from the event log and each sink database as E4's does
reporting_rules: Descriptive only; no test. Reported as post hoc.

Per arm: median and range of commits after the stop took effect (post_enforcement_commits) and of legitimate calls discarded (cancelled_legitimate plus denied_after_enforcement, E4's cost metric). Per replicate: the halt minus revoke difference, with its median, range and the number of replicates where it is 0.
The front figure's panel (a) and the abstract's stop counts will be taken from E4c for this cell, whatever they show; E4's fixed-phase result stays in Section 4, labelled as fixed phase.
Any fence-arm commit after enforcement, duplicate effect or inconsistent audit is reported as an implementation finding.
